name: Laravel
author: alex@example.com
description:
A Laravel egg with PHP-FPM and Nginx in a single container.

Supports Git cloning, Composer, NPM builds, Artisan commands, queue workers, Horizon, task scheduling, WebSockets (Reverb), Cloudflare Tunnels, and automatic SSL.

PHP version is selectable via the Docker image dropdown (8.2, 8.3, 8.4).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Laravel Egg — Installation Script
# Runs inside the installer container to prepare /mnt/server

apt update
apt install -y git curl jq

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Create directory structure (www is created by git clone or below)
mkdir -p logs tmp/sessions tmp/nginx
mkdir -p conf/nginx/conf.d conf/php/pool.d

# Handle user-uploaded files
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "User upload mode — skipping git clone and config download."
    mkdir -p www/public
    exit 0
fi

# Download default configs from the repository
REPO_RAW="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cerbonix/laravel-egg/main"

echo "Downloading default configuration files..."
curl -sSL "${REPO_RAW}/conf/nginx/nginx.conf"         -o conf/nginx/nginx.conf
curl -sSL "${REPO_RAW}/conf/nginx/conf.d/default.conf" -o conf/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
curl -sSL "${REPO_RAW}/conf/php/php.ini"               -o conf/php/php.ini
curl -sSL "${REPO_RAW}/conf/php/php-fpm.conf"          -o conf/php/php-fpm.conf
curl -sSL "${REPO_RAW}/conf/php/pool.d/www.conf"       -o conf/php/pool.d/www.conf

# Clone Git repository if address is provided
if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    # Append .git if missing
    if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
    fi

    # Build authenticated URL if credentials provided
    GIT_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        GIT_URL="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi

    echo "Cloning repository..."
    if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_URL} /mnt/server/www
    else
        git clone ${GIT_URL} /mnt/server/www
    fi

    # Copy .env.example to .env if present
    if [ -f /mnt/server/www/.env.example ]; then
        cp /mnt/server/www/.env.example /mnt/server/www/.env
        echo "Copied .env.example to .env"
    fi
else
    echo "No GIT_ADDRESS provided — creating default index.php"
    mkdir -p www/public
    echo '<?php phpinfo();' > /mnt/server/www/public/index.php
fi

echo "Installation complete."
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description:
The HTTPS URL of the Git repository to clone.

Example: https://github.com/laravel/laravel

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username for private repository authentication.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Personal Access Token for private repository authentication.

https://github.com/settings/tokens

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Pull the latest changes from Git on each startup.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: App Name
variables.description: The Laravel application name (APP_NAME in .env).

variables.name: App Environment
variables.description:
The application environment.

Common values: production, staging, local

variables.name: App Debug
variables.description:
Enable debug mode. Set to false in production.

true = enabled
false = disabled (default)

variables.name: App URL
variables.description:
The public URL of the application.

Example: https://myapp.example.com

variables.name: App Key
variables.description: Laravel encryption key (base64:...). Leave empty to auto-generate on first start.

variables.name: Database Connection
variables.description:
The database driver to use.

Supported: mysql, pgsql, sqlite, sqlsrv

variables.name: Database Host
variables.description: The hostname or IP of the database server.

variables.name: Database Port
variables.description:
The database server port.

MySQL: 3306 | PostgreSQL: 5432

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: The name of the database to use.

variables.name: Database Username
variables.description: The database user.

variables.name: Database Password
variables.description: The database password.

variables.name: Redis Host
variables.description: The hostname or IP of the Redis server.

variables.name: Redis Port
variables.description: The Redis server port.

variables.name: Redis Password
variables.description: The Redis password. Leave empty if no authentication is required.

variables.name: Enable NPM Build
variables.description:
Run NPM install and build on startup.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: NPM Build Command
variables.description:
The NPM build command to run.

Default: npm run build

variables.name: Enable Migrations
variables.description:
Run database migrations on startup.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Enable Queue Worker
variables.description:
Start a background queue worker on startup.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Queue Connection
variables.description:
The queue driver to use.

Common values: sync, database, redis, sqs

variables.name: Enable Horizon
variables.description:
Use Laravel Horizon instead of the default queue worker.
Requires the laravel/horizon package.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Enable Scheduler
variables.description:
Run the Laravel task scheduler in the background.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Enable WebSockets
variables.description:
Start Laravel Reverb WebSocket server.
Requires the laravel/reverb package.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Enable SSL
variables.description:
Enable automatic SSL via Certbot (Let's Encrypt).
Requires CERTBOT_EMAIL and CERTBOT_DOMAIN to be set.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Certbot Email
variables.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt certificate registration.

variables.name: Certbot Domain
variables.description:
The domain name for the SSL certificate.

Example: myapp.example.com

variables.name: Certbot Staging
variables.description:
Use Let's Encrypt staging server for testing.

0 = production (default)
1 = staging

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description:
Cloudflare Tunnel token for exposing the application.
Leave empty to disable.

Get a token from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip Git clone during installation. Use this when uploading files manually via SFTP.

0 = disabled (default)
1 = enabled

variables.name: Custom Artisan Commands
variables.description:
Comma-separated list of artisan commands to run on startup.

Example: db:seed, cache:clear, route:cache

variables.name: WebSocket Port
variables.description:
The port for the Laravel Reverb WebSocket server.
Requires a secondary allocation in Pterodactyl.
